Mixture-of-Experts Neural Fields (MoE-INR) is a neural representation for scientific volume data that partitions the spatial domain into distinct subdomains, each modeled by a specialized expert decoder [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that MoE-INR is a neural representation for scientific volume data that partitions the spatial domain into distinct subdomains, each modeled by a specialized expert decoder. The evidence explicitly states that 'MoE-INR... routes coordinates through a policy network to one of seven expert decoders, each specializing in a spatially distinct subdomain.' It also mentions the use of a shared encoder and discusses performance on scientific datasets (combustion and ionization data), confirming it is a neural representation for such data. All facts in the claim are present and supported by the evidence.
